description: Defines the 'Article' domain model class with properties such as Id, Slug, Title, Description, Body, Author, Comments, and related metadata like Favorites and Tags.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents an article with properties for content, author, comments, tags, and favorite metrics.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Indicates whether the article has any favorites.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of favorites for the article.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Provides a list of tag identifiers associated with the article.
